### Rejoice in God's Compassionate Love
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-february-24-2016.html
Passage: Zechariah 1:13-14
Points:
- The Lord meets anxious prayers with gracious and comforting promises.
- God possesses an immeasurable love and protective jealousy for His people.
- Even when the Lord must chasten, His heart remains deeply affectionate toward His church.
- Divine discipline never signals that God has abandoned or forgotten His servants.
- The Lord knows and tends to every individual believer with intimate care.

### Zechariah's First Vision
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/zechariahs-first-vision
Passage: Zechariah 1:7-17
Points:
- Zechariah witnesses angelic horsemen reporting that the surrounding nations are tranquil and secure.
- This widespread peace troubled the angel because Jerusalem still lingered under the shadow of exile.
- The Lord answers with comforting words, revealing His fiery jealousy for Zion and anger toward careless nations.
- God reassures the post-exilic community that their current hardship does not mean they are forgotten.
- Believers are reminded that despite the temporary prosperity of the wicked, God's people will triumph.
